description: This file implements the lexical analyzer (lexer) for the Lua programming language, responsible for tokenizing source code input.

methods.name: luaX_init
methods.description: Initializes reserved keywords for the lexer.

methods.name: luaX_token2str
methods.description: Converts a token to its string representation.

methods.name: luaX_lexerror
methods.description: Handles lexical errors, providing source location and message.

methods.name: luaX_newstring
methods.description: Creates a new string object in Lua from C string.

methods.name: luaX_setinput
methods.description: Initializes the lexer with input source and state.

methods.name: luaX_next
methods.description: Advances to the next token in the input stream.

methods.name: luaX_lookahead
methods.description: Peeks at the next token without consuming it.
